text:
nora (Finance): Heads-up — Aurora Thera (INV-8421, $18,450.00) just failed payment. Card on file declined with `authorization_hold` from issuer. Customer @aurora-rep is pinging support now. Need a plan: manual retry, wait, or ask for wire?

sam (Payments): Got it. Can you paste last4 and auth code? Also did 3DS trigger?

mira (Support): Customer saw a 3DS challenge and completed it successfully. Our logs show: `decline_code: 402`, `reason: auth_hold_by_issuer`. Last4 is 4242, auth_code 78A2C.

leo (Billing Ops): Auth_hold usually means issuer put a temporary block — retries often fail if we hammer. Recommend: hold autos-retry for 30m, then one controlled retry. If that fails, offer wire instructions.

sam (Payments): Agreed. I'll pause the scheduled retries. Also going to open a payment dispute ticket with our acquirer to check if they can release the hold (they sometimes can for corporate cards).

billing-bot: Invoice INV-8421 status updated -> payment_failed (reason: authorization_hold)

nora (Finance): Thanks. Mira, can you ask Aurora whether they can pay by wire today? If yes, ask them to confirm beneficiary name and whether they need our EU bank details. If they prefer retry, we can do one attempt at 15:10 UTC.

mira (Support): On it. Customer says they can do wire but needs our bank IBAN and a reference to avoid reconciliation delays.

leo (Billing Ops): Draft wire template (send this to customer) — copy/paste only, no account numbers in slack: 
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank: [Bank Name]
IBAN: [IBAN]
BIC/SWIFT: [SWIFT]
Amount: $18,450.00
Reference: INV-8421 / AuroraThera
```

sam (Payments): Once they confirm, finance should approve manual settlement with accounting so we can mark invoice paid on receipt of funds. If they initiate wire, expect 1-3 business days for EU bank.

nora (Finance): Approve. I'll prepare the accounting note and mark for manual settlement on confirmation of funds. Leo — please hold the retry until I say go.

leo (Billing Ops): Holding retry. I'll schedule one controlled attempt at 2148501910 if you don't instruct otherwise. (That’s ~45m)

mira (Support): Customer confirmed they will attempt wire today and will share a payment trace/reference once sent. Also asked if we can temporarily extend service window until funds clear. They’re mid-month and need uptime.

sam (Payments): We can enable a temporary grace hold for 72 hours on this account, flagging it in billing so no auto-suspend. I'll create the flag now.

nora (Finance): Please add a note with payment terms and next steps. Mira — once you have their wire trace, paste here and I’ll route to accounting for reconciliation.

mira (Support): Will do. Sending customer the wire template now.

leo (Billing Ops): Noted. I'll also add a quick reconciliation rule: match by reference INV-8421 and amount, then auto-apply to invoice when cleared.

nora (Finance): Thanks team. Action items: 1) Mira — collect wire trace and confirm. 2) Sam — hold retries and flag account grace. 3) Leo — schedule controlled retry but do not run if wire confirmed. 4) Nora — approve manual settlement on receipt.

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled -> follow-up check at 2148501600 (30m)

mira (Support): Customer acknowledged and will send wire trace within a few hours. Closing loop here until we get trace.

nora (Finance): Perfect. Please escalate to me if the acquirer reports anything different. Thanks all :thumbsup:
